unit.title: Basic English Sentences: Subject and Verb
unit.overview: Build the foundation for English sentence structure by identifying subjects and verbs and forming simple present-tense statements.

objectives: Identify the subject and main verb in a basic English sentence.
Understand the basic Subject + Verb sentence pattern.
Use the present simple for basic facts and routines.

focus: verb agreement in basic present-simple sentences

grammar: Identify the subject and verb in simple sentences.
Choose the correct present-simple verb form.
vocabulary: Match everyday action verbs with meanings.
Use target verbs in short sentences.
output: Write five sentences about your daily activities.
Produce short present-simple sentences using the target patterns.

grammar: At least 7/10 correct on sentence structure and present-simple formation.
vocabulary: Correctly use at least 7 target words in context.
output: Produce at least 5 understandable affirmative sentences independently.
